entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hi, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Oh, hello. I hope you can help me. I'm a bit lost. I bought some shoes, and I think I need to send them back. The website was so confusing.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the cycling shoes? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?

A preference? I... I don't really know. They just hurt. I've tried them a few times and they've given me terrible blisters on my heels. And the little metal things on the bottom, the cleats, they feel strange when I walk. It's just not working for me.

I'm very sorry to hear the shoes are causing blisters; that definitely shouldn't be happening. Comfort is key. Let me pull up your account to check the return eligibility. Do you have your order number handy?
Oh, an order number. Um, I think so... one second. Okay, yes. It's VF987654.
Thank you. Let me just pull that up... Okay, I see the order for the VeloFit Pro cycling shoes, delivered on November 1st. That was about 52 days ago.
Is that bad? Is it too late? I wasn't sure what the policy was. Can't you just help me? I just want a refund.

No worries at all. Let me just confirm our policy for you. According to our system, standard items like these shoes are eligible for return within 90 days of delivery. You are well within that timeframe.
Oh, really? So it's okay? That's such a relief! I was so worried I was stuck with them.
It's absolutely okay. I can go ahead and process this return for a full refund for you right now. I'm sending a prepaid return label to the email address on your account as we speak.
Wow, that's amazing! Thank you so much, Sarah. You've made this so simple.

You're very welcome! Just print that label, pack the shoes in their original box, and drop it at any post office. Once we receive it, we'll issue the refund. Is there anything else I can help with today?
No, that was everything. Thank you again for your help!
My pleasure. Have a wonderful day!
